rows.note: Use 核心 as the all-purpose choice for the key or central part, including a CPU core in technical contexts.

example.english: Each core in this computer helps it run faster.
example.traditional: 呢部電腦嘅每個核心都令佢行得快啲。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 din6 nou5 ge3 mui5 go3 hat6 sam1 dou1 ling6 keoi5 haang4 dak1 faai3 di1

rows.note: Use 果芯 for the central part of a fruit such as an apple, especially when referring to the part left after eating it.

example.english: I finished the apple and only the core was left.
example.traditional: 我食完個蘋果，淨返個果芯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sik6 jyun4 go3 ping4 gwo2 zing6 faan1 go3 gwo2 sam1

rows.note: Use 中心 for the physical centre of a space, shape, or area rather than its important idea.

example.english: A fountain sits in the core of the circular park.
example.traditional: 個圓形公園嘅中心有個噴水池。
example.jyutping: go3 jyun4 jing4 gung1 jyun4 ge3 zung1 sam1 jau5 go3 pan3 seoi2 ci4

rows.note: Use 內部 for the inside or inner part of a physical object when it is not specifically its centre or essential part.

example.english: The inner core of this old speaker is covered in dust.
example.traditional: 呢個舊喇叭嘅內部積滿晒塵。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gau6 laa3 baa1 ge3 noi6 bou6 zik1 mun5 saai3 can4
